main_body: A grey stone/metal machine housing with two small pillars on top and a large dark front panel carrying a purple orb with a gold ring, drawn face-on.
top_band: Rows 16-21 at x=24: a light grey band (L=172/136/172) that reads as a flat raised ledge with a slot, followed by an L=52 shadow row. The body below is the front panel (rows 24-46, L=71). No top surface is visible from above, only a 1px light edge at row 21.
evidence: The main body (rows 22-46) is a flat, dark front panel with a centred orb and rivets, all painted flat on the surface with no inset. The grey band above (rows 16-21) is a vertical face, a parapet with a slot, not a horizontal surface. The only candidate top is a 1px light line at row 21, which is a rim. The two pillars on top are small details and show only a 1px cap line. This is a front elevation with a light band on top.

style.evidence: The candidate has only 12 distinct colours and a median of 7 per tile, against 17-20 for the references. Its flat-fill coverage is 43% against 0-13%. The large dark panel (about 70x23 px) is one flat tone with only sparse rivet dots. The grey stone ramp has about 3 steps (light edge, mid, dark) against 5-6 in the references. The outline is partly neutral near-black (37% neutral) and partly cool-tinted, so mixed. The orb is nicely shaded but is a small area, and the rest of the piece is thinner and flatter than the Beodeul pieces.
